categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `src/rpc/net.cpp` parameter validation for the `setban` RPC method.
categories.rationale: Prevents signed integer overflow and silent ban drops when callers provide relative ban times near INT64_MAX. As noted in the description, 'GetTime() + bantime... wraps negative, causing the node to treat the ban as already expired and silently drop it while setban still returns success.'

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: The one-line edit in `src/init.cpp` clamping `-bantime` is a settings adjustment whose purpose is peer banning behavior; utils explicitly excludes settings changes whose point is another area's behavior.
categories.rationale: Not a utils change; the single-line clamp to `-bantime` in init.cpp serves peer-banning logic rather than shared infrastructure.
